messages:
marco: Heads-up — driver 536.03 rolled to ap-southeast-1 H100 pool at 03:12 UTC. We're getting multiple NCCL allreduce hangs and pods stuck in Init across Dedicated nodes.

lina: Symptoms? logs / Xid codes?

jess: Sample dmesg from one host:
```
[ 90123.456789] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3e:00): 79
[ 90123.456900] nvrm: RmInitAdapter failed: -1
cuda: invalid device function
ncclCommInitRank: Timeout during clique creation
```

ops-oncall: Confirming: several nodes reported nvlink resets and driver kill events. Scheduler shows pods in Running but stuck at InitContainers for MIG setup on some hosts.

marco: Observed pattern: images built in last 48h with nvcc 12.3 are fine; older images built with nvcc 11.8/11.7 targeting sm_90 hit invalid-device-function. Looks like JIT/linker rejects older PTX variants.

lina: So prebuilt SASS vs JIT path divergence. If JIT fails, runtime currently swallows and NCCL waits forever. Need fail-fast.

jess: Reproduced locally by running the older image on a node with driver 536.03 — cuobjdump shows PTX header differences and the runtime prints a JIT assembly error if you run `cuLinkCreate` manually.

ops-oncall: Immediate mitigation plan: (1) cordon & taint impacted nodes (gpu:outage=true), (2) rollback driver on a small wave and prioritize Dedicated allocations, (3) add scheduling guard to avoid placing legacy images on driver>=536 nodes. Initiating rollback wave-1 now.

deploy-bot: rollback-driver ap-southeast-1 h100-wave-1 initiated by ops-oncall at 1800123468

runtime-bot: Filing runtime issue: #502 — surface JIT link failures, fail kernel launch, and set pod status to Failed with diagnostic. Attaching reproducer and cuobjdump output.

marco: Long-term fixes: (a) CI image rebuild job that compiles CUDA kernels for sm_90 with nvcc 12.2/12.3 and includes both PTX+SASS artifacts, (b) admission controller/mutating webhook to block scheduling images missing SASS onto upgraded nodes, (c) runtime fallback to load precompiled SASS blobs when JIT link fails (but fail-fast if neither available).

jess: I'll add a small smoke test that runs an NCCL allreduce across 4 GPUs as part of the driver upgrade playbook; canary nodes should run that before being considered healthy.

cloud-partner-bot: Note from vendor: driver 536.x tightened PTX JIT parsing for SM90 to avoid ambiguous asm -> intended behaviour, recommended nvcc >= 12.2. They will follow up if a micro-fix is planned.

lina: Ops follow-up: keep rollback until images rebuilt and runtime patch lands. We'll do a controlled re-rollout with a canary window: rebuild images, merge runtime PR, run smoke, re-enable driver on <5 nodes, watch Xids and NCCL metrics for 2 hours.

ops-oncall: Wave-1 rollback completed to 535.86 on affected hosts. Monitoring NCCL error rate and scheduler stability.

marco: I'll write the short runbook for oncall: detection queries (Xid 79 spike, nccl timeouts), mitigation steps, labels to prevent scheduling legacy toolchains, and escalation path to vendor.

jess: CI image rebuild ETA ~4h. Runtime PR for fail-fast & clearer logs ready for review. Once merged, we can re-run canary.

marco: Thanks — key action items assigned: jess=CI rebuild, lina=admission gate, runtime-bot=issue tracker, ops-oncall=rollback and canary. Re-open thread with canary results. :thumbsup:
